guides.name: Kyoto, Japan
guides.description: Japan's old capital: wooden machiya streets, gardens and over a thousand temples.
guides.details: Spring blossom and autumn leaves are peak season; summer is hot and humid. Fill days with shrines and gardens, evenings with izakaya in Pontocho. Stay near Kyoto Station or Gion; buses and the subway cover the sights.

activities.title: Fushimi Inari torii gate hike
activities.description: Walk the vermilion gate tunnels up Mount Inari before the crowds.

activities.title: Arashiyama bamboo grove and Tenryu-ji
activities.description: Stroll the bamboo grove, then the Zen garden at Tenryu-ji.

activities.title: Kiyomizu-dera and Higashiyama lanes
activities.description: The wooden stage temple, then the stepped lanes of Sannenzaka.

activities.title: Nishiki Market tasting walk
activities.description: Graze on pickles, tamagoyaki and skewers along 'Kyoto's kitchen'.

activities.title: Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion
activities.description: The gold-leafed pavilion mirrored in its pond.

activities.title: Gion evening walk
activities.description: Lantern-lit Hanamikoji Street and the Shirakawa canal at dusk.

activities.title: Pontocho izakaya dinner
activities.description: Small plates and sake in the narrow riverside alley.

guides.name: Bali, Indonesia
guides.description: Rice terraces, surf beaches and temple ceremonies on Indonesia's island of the gods.
guides.details: April to October is the dry season; the rest brings tropical downpours. Split time between Ubud for culture and the south coast for beaches. Villas are good value for groups; hire a driver to get around.

activities.title: Tegallalang rice terraces
activities.description: Walk the terraced paddies north of Ubud in the soft morning light.

activities.title: Ubud Monkey Forest and market
activities.description: The sacred forest temple, then Ubud's craft market.

activities.title: Uluwatu Temple sunset and Kecak dance
activities.description: Clifftop temple at sunset, followed by the fire dance.

activities.title: Surf lesson at Kuta or Canggu
activities.description: Beginner-friendly beach breaks with a local instructor.

activities.title: Beach club afternoon
activities.description: Pool, sea view and a slow lunch at a Seminyak beach club.

activities.title: Tirta Empul water temple
activities.description: The spring-fed purification pools of a working temple.

activities.title: Jimbaran seafood dinner on the sand
activities.description: Grilled catch of the day at tables on the beach.

guides.name: Phuket, Thailand
guides.description: Thailand's biggest island: long beaches, limestone bays and lively nights.
guides.details: November to April is dry and calm; May to October brings rough seas on the west coast. Base in Kata or Karon for beaches, Patong for nightlife. Island-hop by longtail or speedboat; tuk-tuks and Grab cover the rest.

activities.title: Phang Nga Bay boat trip
activities.description: Limestone karsts, sea caves and James Bond Island by boat.

activities.title: Kata Beach swim and lounge
activities.description: Golden sand and clear water on the south-west coast.

activities.title: Big Buddha viewpoint
activities.description: The 45-metre marble Buddha with island-wide views.

activities.title: Phuket Old Town walk
activities.description: Sino-Portuguese shophouses, cafés and street art.

activities.title: Promthep Cape sunset
activities.description: The island's southern tip, made for sunset.

activities.title: Bangla Road night out
activities.description: Patong's neon-lit nightlife strip.

activities.title: Weekend night market dinner
activities.description: Street food and stalls at the Naka market.

guides.name: Da Nang, Vietnam
guides.description: A breezy beach city between the Marble Mountains and lantern-lit Hoi An.
guides.details: February to May is the sweet spot; autumn brings typhoon rain. Mix My Khe Beach days with a trip to Hoi An's old town and the Ba Na Hills. Excellent value: beachfront hotels and Grab rides are cheap.

activities.title: My Khe Beach morning
activities.description: Swim and coffee on Da Nang's long city beach.

activities.title: Marble Mountains caves and pagodas
activities.description: Climb through grottoes and shrines inside the marble hills.

activities.title: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.description: Cable car to the hilltop and the giant-hands bridge.

activities.title: Hoi An Ancient Town
activities.description: Merchant houses, the Japanese Covered Bridge and tailors.

activities.title: Hoi An lantern river evening
activities.description: Float a lantern on the Thu Bon River at dusk.

activities.title: Mi Quang and banh mi food crawl
activities.description: Da Nang's own noodles and the famous Hoi An banh mi.

activities.title: Dragon Bridge and night market
activities.description: Watch the bridge breathe fire (weekends), then the Son Tra market.

guides.name: Bangkok, Thailand
guides.description: Golden temples, canal boats and some of the world's best street food.
guides.details: November to February is the cool, dry season; April is hottest. Temples by morning, malls or a massage in the afternoon heat, markets and rooftops at night. The BTS, MRT and river ferries beat the traffic.

activities.title: Grand Palace and Wat Pho
activities.description: The royal palace, then the Reclining Buddha next door.

activities.title: Wat Arun by river ferry
activities.description: Cross the Chao Phraya to the porcelain-tiled Temple of Dawn.

activities.title: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.description: Thousands of stalls for clothes, crafts and snacks.

activities.title: Thai massage at Wat Pho school
activities.description: A traditional massage where the craft is taught.

activities.title: Siam shopping afternoon
activities.description: Air-conditioned escape through Siam Paragon and MBK.

activities.title: Yaowarat street food night
activities.description: Chinatown's neon street of seafood, noodles and desserts.

activities.title: Rooftop bar sunset
activities.description: Skyline drinks above the river.

guides.name: Seoul, South Korea
guides.description: Palaces beside neon districts, Korean barbecue and all-night shopping.
guides.details: Spring and autumn are mild and clear; winter is very cold, summer humid. Pair palaces and hanok villages with Myeongdong and Hongdae for food and shopping. The subway reaches everything; stay near Myeongdong or Hongdae.

activities.title: Gyeongbokgung Palace guard ceremony
activities.description: The main Joseon palace and its changing of the guard.

activities.title: Bukchon Hanok Village walk
activities.description: Lanes of traditional tiled-roof houses between two palaces.

activities.title: Myeongdong street food and beauty shops
activities.description: Skewers, egg bread and K-beauty stores.

activities.title: N Seoul Tower at dusk
activities.description: Cable car up Namsan for the city lights.

activities.title: Gwangjang Market lunch
activities.description: Bindaetteok pancakes and kalguksu at the old market.

activities.title: Hongdae night out
activities.description: Buskers, bars and karaoke in the university district.

activities.title: Korean barbecue dinner
activities.description: Grill-your-own pork belly and soju.

guides.name: Lisbon, Portugal
guides.description: Pastel hills, yellow trams and custard tarts on the Atlantic coast.
guides.details: Spring and early autumn are warm without the summer crowds. Explore Alfama and Belém by day, Bairro Alto by night, and take a day trip to Sintra. Trams and the metro are cheap; the hills are steep, so bring good shoes.

activities.title: Tram 28 through Alfama
activities.description: Ride the vintage tram up through the old Moorish quarter.

activities.title: Belém Tower and pastéis de Belém
activities.description: The riverside tower, Jerónimos Monastery and the original custard tarts.

activities.title: Sintra palaces day trip
activities.description: Pena Palace and the Moorish Castle in the hills.

activities.title: Time Out Market lunch
activities.description: A food hall of Lisbon's best cooks under one roof.

activities.title: Miradouro sunset
activities.description: Golden hour over the rooftops from a city viewpoint.

activities.title: Fado dinner in Alfama
activities.description: Portugal's soulful music over a traditional dinner.

activities.title: Bairro Alto bar hop
activities.description: Street-side drinks in the lively upper town.

guides.name: Barcelona, Spain
guides.description: Gaudí's city by the sea: modernist landmarks, tapas bars and a city beach.
guides.details: May, June and September are warm without peak crowds. Book the Sagrada Família ahead; pair Gaudí mornings with beach afternoons and late tapas. The metro is quick; the Gothic Quarter is best on foot.

activities.title: Sagrada Família
activities.description: Gaudí's unfinished basilica and its light-filled nave.

activities.title: Park Güell
activities.description: Mosaic terraces and city views.

activities.title: Gothic Quarter walk
activities.description: Medieval lanes, the cathedral and hidden squares.

activities.title: La Boqueria market
activities.description: Fresh juice, jamón and seafood at the famous market.

activities.title: Barceloneta beach afternoon
activities.description: Swim and sunbathe on the city's beach.

activities.title: Tapas crawl in El Born
activities.description: Pintxos and vermouth in Born's small bars.

activities.title: Montjuïc sunset
activities.description: Gardens and views from the hill above the port.

guides.name: Rome, Italy
guides.description: Three thousand years of history around every corner, and pasta to match.
guides.details: April to June and September to October are best; August is hot and crowded. Book the Colosseum and Vatican ahead; save evenings for Trastevere trattorias. The historic centre is walkable; the metro covers the rest.

activities.title: Colosseum and Roman Forum
activities.description: The arena and the ruins of the ancient city centre.

activities.title: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
activities.description: Michelangelo's ceiling and the papal collections.

activities.title: Pantheon and Trevi Fountain walk
activities.description: Piazza Navona, the Pantheon and a coin in the Trevi.

activities.title: Gelato and Spanish Steps
activities.description: An afternoon stroll from the Steps down Via del Corso.

activities.title: Borghese Gallery and gardens
activities.description: Bernini sculptures in a villa park.

activities.title: Trastevere trattoria dinner
activities.description: Cacio e pepe and carbonara in cobbled lanes.

activities.title: Campo de' Fiori aperitivo
activities.description: Spritz and snacks on a lively square.

guides.name: Reykjavik, Iceland
guides.description: The gateway to waterfalls, glaciers, geothermal lagoons and the northern lights.
guides.details: June to August brings midnight sun and open roads; September to March, the aurora. Day trips run the Golden Circle and the south coast; weather changes fast, so pack layers. Iceland is expensive: self-catering saves a lot.

activities.title: Golden Circle day tour
activities.description: Þingvellir rift valley, Geysir and Gullfoss waterfall.

activities.title: South coast waterfalls
activities.description: Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and the black sand of Reynisfjara.

activities.title: Blue Lagoon soak
activities.description: Milky geothermal water in a lava field.

activities.title: Hallgrímskirkja and old town
activities.description: The basalt-column church tower and the harbour streets.

activities.title: Northern lights tour
activities.description: Chase the aurora away from city lights (winter months).

activities.title: Icelandic dinner downtown
activities.description: Lamb soup, arctic char and skyr.

guides.name: Cape Town, South Africa
guides.description: Table Mountain above Atlantic beaches, penguins and the winelands.
guides.details: November to March is warm and dry; winter is green and wet. Hike or cable car up Table Mountain, drive the Cape Peninsula, lunch in Stellenbosch. Stay in the City Bowl or Camps Bay; use Uber after dark.

activities.title: Table Mountain
activities.description: Hike Platteklip Gorge or ride the cableway to the top.

activities.title: Cape Peninsula and Boulders Beach penguins
activities.description: Chapman's Peak, the Cape of Good Hope and the penguin colony.

activities.title: Stellenbosch wine tasting
activities.description: Estates and tastings in the winelands.

activities.title: V&A Waterfront
activities.description: Harbour, markets and the Zeitz MOCAA gallery.

activities.title: Camps Bay sunset
activities.description: Palm-lined beach under the Twelve Apostles.

activities.title: Bo-Kaap Cape Malay dinner
activities.description: Bobotie and curries in the colourful quarter.

guides.name: Sydney, Australia
guides.description: Harbour icons, ocean pools and a famous coastal walk.
guides.details: Spring and autumn are mild; December to February is beach season. Mix harbour sights with Bondi and Manly, and a day in the Blue Mountains. Ferries are the best way to see the harbour; an Opal card covers everything.

activities.title: Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
activities.description: Clifftop path past ocean pools and beaches.

activities.title: Opera House and Royal Botanic Garden
activities.description: Circular Quay, the Opera House and harbour gardens.

activities.title: Ferry to Manly
activities.description: The classic harbour ferry ride, then the beach.

activities.title: Blue Mountains day trip
activities.description: The Three Sisters and eucalyptus valleys.

activities.title: Taronga Zoo
activities.description: Australian wildlife with harbour views.

activities.title: The Rocks dinner
activities.description: Pubs and restaurants in Sydney's oldest quarter.

activities.title: Darling Harbour night
activities.description: Waterfront bars and the city lights.

guides.name: Cancun, Mexico
guides.description: Caribbean beaches, cenotes and Mayan ruins on the Yucatán coast.
guides.details: December to April is dry and sunny; June to November is hurricane season. Beach days in the Hotel Zone, a ferry to Isla Mujeres, a day at Chichén Itzá or Tulum. Buses are cheap; tours handle the ruins.

activities.title: Isla Mujeres ferry and Playa Norte
activities.description: Calm turquoise water on a small island.

activities.title: Chichén Itzá and cenote swim
activities.description: The great Mayan pyramid, then a swim in a sinkhole.

activities.title: Tulum ruins by the sea
activities.description: Clifftop Mayan ruins above the Caribbean.

activities.title: Hotel Zone beach afternoon
activities.description: White sand and swimming at Playa Delfines.

activities.title: Snorkel the underwater museum (MUSA)
activities.description: Sculptures on the reef off Isla Mujeres.

activities.title: Tacos in El Centro
activities.description: Tacos al pastor where the locals eat.

activities.title: Party Center night out
activities.description: Cancún's clubs on the Hotel Zone strip.

guides.name: Niseko, Japan
guides.description: Hokkaido's powder-snow capital, with onsen and ramen after the slopes.
guides.details: December to March has famously light powder; summer is for hiking and rafting. Ski the linked Niseko United resorts, soak in an onsen, eat in Hirafu village. Fly into Sapporo and take the resort bus.

activities.title: Full day on the Niseko United slopes
activities.description: Grand Hirafu, Hanazono and Annupuri on one lift pass.

activities.title: Ski or snowboard lesson
activities.description: Group lesson for beginners and improvers.

activities.title: Snowshoe walk
activities.description: Quiet forest trails in deep snow.

activities.title: Onsen soak
activities.description: Outdoor hot springs with views of Mount Yotei.

activities.title: Night skiing under lights
activities.description: Floodlit runs on Grand Hirafu.

activities.title: Hirafu village ramen and izakaya
activities.description: Miso ramen and Hokkaido seafood.

guides.name: Chamonix, France
guides.description: An Alpine town under Mont Blanc, for skiing in winter and high trails in summer.
guides.details: Ski December to April; hike June to September. Ride to the Aiguille du Midi for Mont Blanc views; the valley bus links every resort. Stay in town; it is lively and walkable.

activities.title: Aiguille du Midi cable car
activities.description: Up to 3,842 metres facing Mont Blanc.

activities.title: Skiing at Brévent-Flégère
activities.description: Sunny slopes facing the Mont Blanc massif.

activities.title: Montenvers train to the Mer de Glace
activities.description: Rack railway to France's largest glacier and its ice cave.

activities.title: Lac Blanc hike (summer)
activities.description: A classic trail to an Alpine lake mirroring the peaks.

activities.title: Town centre and riverside stroll
activities.description: The Arve river, shops and Alpine museum.

activities.title: Savoyard fondue dinner
activities.description: Fondue or tartiflette by the fire.

activities.title: Après-ski in town
activities.description: Bars along Rue des Moulins.

guides.name: Banff, Canada
guides.description: Turquoise lakes, Rocky Mountain peaks and wildlife in Canada's first national park.
guides.details: Summer is for lakes and trails; December to April for skiing at three resorts. Lake Louise and Moraine Lake are the icons; drive the Icefields Parkway if you can. Stay in Banff town; Roam buses link the sights.

activities.title: Lake Louise and the Lake Agnes teahouse
activities.description: The famous lake, then a hike to a mountain teahouse.

activities.title: Moraine Lake
activities.description: Ten peaks above a glacier-blue lake (shuttle in summer).

activities.title: Skiing at Sunshine Village
activities.description: High-altitude powder on the Continental Divide.

activities.title: Banff Gondola
activities.description: Up Sulphur Mountain for the valley view.

activities.title: Johnston Canyon walk
activities.description: Catwalks past waterfalls in a limestone canyon.

activities.title: Banff Upper Hot Springs
activities.description: A mountain-view thermal pool.

activities.title: Banff Avenue dinner
activities.description: Alberta beef and cosy mountain pubs.

guides.name: Queenstown, New Zealand
guides.description: New Zealand's adventure capital on a lake ringed by the Remarkables.
guides.details: Summer is for hiking and lake days; June to September for skiing. Bungy, jet boats and a day trip to Milford Sound are the classics. The town is walkable; tours pick up from hotels.

activities.title: Milford Sound cruise
activities.description: Fiordland's waterfalls and sheer cliffs by boat.

activities.title: Kawarau Bridge bungy or Shotover jet
activities.description: The original bungy, or a jet boat through the canyon.

activities.title: Skyline gondola and luge
activities.description: Views over Lake Wakatipu, then race down the luge.

activities.title: Queenstown Hill walk
activities.description: A short climb to the 'Basket of Dreams' viewpoint.

activities.title: Skiing at The Remarkables
activities.description: Family-friendly slopes above the lake (winter).

activities.title: Arrowtown and Gibbston wine
activities.description: A gold-rush village, then wineries in the valley.

activities.title: Fergburger and lakefront evening
activities.description: The famous burger, then the waterfront.

guides.name: Kathmandu, Nepal
guides.description: Temple squares, prayer flags and the gateway to Himalayan treks.
guides.details: October to November and March to April have clear mountain views. Explore the three Durbar Squares, then a short trek or a Himalaya flight. Stay in Thamel; taxis are cheap but agree the fare first.

activities.title: Swayambhunath, the Monkey Temple
activities.description: Hilltop stupa with prayer wheels and valley views.

activities.title: Kathmandu Durbar Square
activities.description: Royal palaces and pagoda temples.

activities.title: Boudhanath stupa at dusk
activities.description: Join the circling pilgrims around the great stupa.

activities.title: Everest mountain flight
activities.description: An early sightseeing flight along the Himalaya.

activities.title: Bhaktapur day trip
activities.description: A medieval Newar town of potters and temples.

activities.title: Nagarkot sunrise hike
activities.description: Short trek on the valley rim with Himalayan views.

activities.title: Thamel momo dinner
activities.description: Dumplings and dal bhat in the backpacker quarter.

guides.name: Torres del Paine, Chile
guides.description: Granite towers, glaciers and wild Patagonian trails at the end of the world.
guides.details: October to April is trekking season; expect wind in any month. Day hikes reach the Base of the Towers and Grey Glacier; the W Trek takes 4-5 days. Stay in Puerto Natales or park lodges; book refugios early.

activities.title: Base of the Towers hike
activities.description: The park's signature climb to the three granite towers.

activities.title: Grey Glacier boat
activities.description: Sail among icebergs to the glacier face.

activities.title: Mirador Cuernos walk
activities.description: An easy trail to views of the Paine horns.

activities.title: Wildlife drive
activities.description: Guanacos, condors and, with luck, a puma.

activities.title: Puerto Natales waterfront
activities.description: The town's seafront and gear shops.

activities.title: Patagonian lamb dinner
activities.description: Cordero al palo and Chilean wine.

guides.name: Tokyo, Japan
guides.description: A vast, safe megacity of shrines, food halls and neon districts.
guides.details: Spring and autumn are mild; summer is hot and humid. The JR and metro reach everything.

activities.title: Senso-ji and Nakamise Street
activities.description: Tokyo's oldest temple and its snack-stall approach.

activities.title: Meiji Shrine and Harajuku
activities.description: Forest shrine, then Takeshita Street.

activities.title: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast
activities.description: Sushi, tamagoyaki and grilled seafood.

activities.title: Shibuya Crossing and Shibuya Sky
activities.description: The famous scramble, then the rooftop view.

activities.title: teamLab digital art museum
activities.description: Immersive light and art installations.

activities.title: Shinjuku Omoide Yokocho dinner
activities.description: Yakitori in tiny smoky alley bars.

activities.title: Akihabara arcades
activities.description: Retro games, arcades and anime shops.

guides.name: Osaka, Japan
guides.description: Japan's kitchen: street food, castles and neon canals.
guides.details: Spring and autumn are best. Kyoto and Nara are easy day trips by train.

activities.title: Osaka Castle and park
activities.description: The landmark castle keep and its moat gardens.

activities.title: Nara deer park day trip
activities.description: Todai-ji's giant Buddha and the bowing deer.

activities.title: Kuromon Market lunch
activities.description: Fresh seafood, wagyu skewers and fruit.

activities.title: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: Super Nintendo World and the big rides.

activities.title: Umeda Sky Building
activities.description: The floating garden observatory.

activities.title: Dotonbori street food night
activities.description: Takoyaki and okonomiyaki under the Glico sign.

activities.title: Shinsekai kushikatsu
activities.description: Fried skewers in the retro district by Tsutenkaku.

guides.name: Taipei, Taiwan
guides.description: Night markets, mountain hot springs and a famous dumpling house.
guides.details: October to April is cooler; summer is hot with typhoons. The MRT is spotless and cheap.

activities.title: Elephant Mountain hike
activities.description: A short, steep climb to the classic Taipei 101 view.

activities.title: National Palace Museum
activities.description: Imperial Chinese treasures, jade cabbage included.

activities.title: Jiufen old street
activities.description: Teahouses and lanterns on a hillside mining town.

activities.title: Beitou hot springs
activities.description: Thermal valley and public baths.

activities.title: Din Tai Fung dumplings
activities.description: Xiaolongbao at the original branch.

activities.title: Shilin Night Market
activities.description: Fried chicken, bubble tea and games.

activities.title: Taipei 101 at night
activities.description: Observatory views over the lit city.

guides.name: Paris, France
guides.description: Museums, cafés and riverside walks in the city of light.
guides.details: Spring and autumn are lovely; August is quiet as locals leave. The metro reaches everything.

activities.title: Louvre highlights
activities.description: The Mona Lisa, Winged Victory and the glass pyramid.

activities.title: Musée d'Orsay
activities.description: Impressionists in a former railway station.

activities.title: Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur
activities.description: Artists' square and the hilltop basilica.

activities.title: Le Marais café and boutique stroll
activities.description: Falafel, galleries and small shops.

activities.title: Eiffel Tower summit
activities.description: Up the tower as the lights come on.

activities.title: Seine river cruise
activities.description: The monuments lit up from the water.

activities.title: Bistro dinner
activities.description: Steak frites and wine in a classic bistro.

guides.name: London, United Kingdom
guides.description: Free world-class museums, royal landmarks and historic pubs.
guides.details: Late spring to early autumn has the best weather; carry an umbrella anyway. Tap in on the Tube.

activities.title: Tower of London
activities.description: The Crown Jewels and the Beefeaters.

activities.title: British Museum
activities.description: The Rosetta Stone and two million years of history, free.

activities.title: Westminster and Buckingham Palace
activities.description: Big Ben, the Abbey and the Changing of the Guard.

activities.title: Borough Market lunch
activities.description: Street food stalls by London Bridge.

activities.title: South Bank walk to Tate Modern
activities.description: Riverside walk to the modern art gallery.

activities.title: West End show
activities.description: A musical or play in Theatreland.

activities.title: Historic pub dinner
activities.description: Pie and a pint in a centuries-old pub.
